intent: Keep a typed local verification-reserve stop distinguishable from generic chat/tool failure in approved reports, using existing public codes and reason vocabulary.
constraints: No change to execution, acceptance, replay, authorization or call limits.
Do not classify a dispatched or unresolved remote operation as a local reserve refusal.
No raw result, cursor, provider text or source value enters approved reports.
The historical chat cause is inferred from the shared run and budget observations; reproduction proves the reporting defect, not the complete historical execution.
